floor_provenance.governs: the TAUGHT RECALL RATE WITH THE ADAPTER ON (per_seed[].primary.k / .n, a count over QUESTIONS). `phase23_prereg.sigma_zero_verdict` reads this floor in 23-10 against the same quantity measured on the σ=0 arm and recorded at results/phase23_sigma_zero.json; a deviation larger than this floor HALTS the whole sweep (D-04) and there is no warning branch and no override flag. It governs THAT quantity and nothing else: every other reading in this record is secondary, recorded with its own denominator and NOT reduced.

governs: WHETHER ANY NOISED SWEEP POINT MAY RUN AT ALL. `proceed` unblocks the first noised run of the milestone; `HALT` blocks every noised point until the cause is root-caused and fixed, and there is no warning branch and no override flag (D-04). The quantity judged is the TAUGHT RECALL RATE WITH THE ADAPTER ON (primary.k / primary.n, a count over QUESTIONS) — the same quantity `results/phase23_control_floor.json` declares its floor governs, and nothing else.

  σ=0 reading      : 0.7837301587301587 (BEATS the control)
  control central  : 0.5615079365079365 (reading at the FIRST recorded seed)
  deviation        : 0.2222222222222222

  σ=0 must reproduce the unmitigated control inside the seed-to-seed floor. It does not. The cause must be ROOT-CAUSED AND FIXED before any noised point runs — this is not a warning and there is no override flag. Every correctness bug in this class IMPROVES utility, which is why a σ=0 that BEATS the control is the signal rather than noise. Stop-and-fix is reversible; publish-compromised is not.

recipe.corpus_digest_source: 23-07-SUMMARY.md — the dp_n8 triple the resume probe recorded

residual_differences.difference: replay lives IN the teaching bin here; it is drawn at TRAIN time on the DP path
residual_differences.matched_quantity: the replay TOKEN volume, which IS matched and recorded as a number in `recipe.replay`
residual_differences.why_not_eliminable: D-10/D-24 put replay outside the teaching bin for DP arms, and `train()`'s replay seam (`replay_bin`/`replay_mask_bin`/`replay_windows`) is wired at `teach_persona.py`'s `dp_kwargs`, gated on `is_dp`. A non-DP arm cannot reach it without widening `DP_ARMS`, which would make the control a DP arm and require a sigma.

residual_differences.difference: grad_accum_steps is 1 here and `n_facts` on the DP path
residual_differences.why_not_eliminable: `dp_accum = dict(grad_accum_steps=stats['n_facts']) if is_dp else {}` — the same `is_dp` predicate. The control's lot is one micro-batch; the DP arm's lot is one privacy record per micro-step (SC2).

residual_differences.difference: the flat v3.0 pack here; the ragged fact-aligned three-bin pack there
residual_differences.matched_quantity: the fact set (`phase14_factset.LOCKED_FACTS`, n=8) and the taught family ids, which ARE identical
residual_differences.why_not_eliminable: the arm NAME is what couples an arm to its packer — `build_arm_bins` reads `DP_ARMS` and nothing else. A control that packed ragged would be a DP arm by name and would need a sigma.

residual_differences.difference: the DP arithmetic itself — per-record clip at C, a summed accumulator, and the division by N last
residual_differences.why_not_eliminable: `DPSGD` is constructed only when `is_dp`. At σ=0 the noise term is exactly zero but the CLIP and the accumulate-then-divide remain, so σ=0 is not the control computation with a zero added to it.

training.bracket_covers: the whole train_arm call: build_arm_bins + base load + the max_steps-step loop (in-loop evals, checkpoint writes, replay memmap I/O) + both end-of-run masked_perplexity sweeps
